key_terms.لَيَقُولُونَ: They surely say / They persist in saying

ai.seo_question: What did the disbelievers say according to Surah Al-Dukhan?
ai.summary: In the context of Surah Al-Dukhan, this verse underscores the obstinate rejection of the Quraysh, who dismissed the Prophet Muhammad's warnings as mere human speech despite the clear signs of divine power. Shia exegetes often highlight this persistent denial as a precursor to the specific plagues mentioned in the subsequent verses, illustrating how verbal arrogance precedes physical punishment.
